description: With cas.max_links 1 and a link already made, a second node's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST is answered PHYSICAL LINK REJECTED with reason 4, too many active links.
note: At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10, so the burst ends by 7000), a type 8 D_PDU carrying a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST. Accepting it would leave the active link count within cas.max_links, so the CAS answers PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED (B-0130, B-0210, B-0211), queued in a type 8 D_PDU; nothing is output during the burst. At 3000 the burst ends with the prediction ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end 4000. At 7000 LBT rule 1 applies (only this node was addressed, K-0067, K-0068), so contention starts at once, slot 15, 45000 ms. At 52000 the accept goes out (Ed4 bit echoed from the request, B-0138, B-0139; LINK 0, B-0137). The link is declared made when that transmission has ended, at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100): link_state linked, D_CONNECTION_MADE to the DTS (C-0571), C_PHYSICAL_LINK_MADE to the SIS, whose soft link is then established (A-0194), and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts with cas.first_data_timeout_ms (B-0215, B-0216). At 61000 0.0.1.4 sends a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (EOT 10, end 66000). One link is active and the limit is 1, so accepting would exceed it: PHYSICAL LINK REJECTED, reason 4 (octet 34) (B-0209, B-0212, B-0313, B-0402). Burst end 62000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 66000 rule 1, slot 4, 12000 ms; at 78000 the reject goes out in a type 8 D_PDU with C_PDU ID 1. Its end at 83550 changes nothing: the link with 0.0.1.3 stays as it is. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so one type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) fills a block exactly and a one-block transmission lasts 5550 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043, C-0350). Every C_PDU of this scenario is a one-octet CAS-1 C_PDU sent once in a type 8 D_PDU (B-0129, B-0143, B-0152, B-0191), C_PDU IDs from 0 (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000.
